combat.detail: Most weapons lose damage past a falloff range: full damage up close, ramping down to a minimum at max range. Shotguns and beam weapons suffer most — stay inside falloff range or mod for it.
combat.title: Damage falloff

combat.detail: Multishot fires extra projectiles per trigger pull at no extra ammo cost. Each projectile rolls crit and status independently, so multishot multiplies both damage and proc output.
combat.title: Multishot

combat.detail: Crits come in tiers by crit chance: Yellow (2x damage), Orange (3x), Red (4x), Purple (5x). Higher tiers need 100%+/200%+/300%+ crit chance. This is why crit builds scale so violently with Arcane Avenger, Harrow and crit mods.
combat.title: Crit tiers: yellow → orange → red → purple

combat.detail: Status chance is per projectile, rolled against each damage type on the weapon. More multishot and fire rate = more procs = faster 10-stack ramps.
combat.title: Status application basics

factions.desc: Heavy armor (Ferrite/Alloy) plus Cloned Flesh health underneath. Strip the armor, then melt the flesh.
factions.name: Grineer
factions.weak: Corrosive (strip Ferrite), Puncture (bonus vs armor), Radiation (vs Alloy elites), then Viral + Slash/Hunter Munitions vs health.

factions.desc: Shields over health, plus robotic units with Alloy Armor. Bypass or break the shields first.
factions.name: Corpus
factions.weak: Magnetic (strips shields), Toxin (bypasses shields entirely), Radiation + Puncture vs robotics.

factions.desc: Swarm health types (Flesh, Infested Sinew), mostly unarmored. AoE and DoTs shine.
factions.name: Infested
factions.weak: Gas + Heat + Slash. Heat panic-locks crowds; Gas clouds chain through packs.

factions.desc: A mix of Grineer and Corrupted-Corpus units with mixed armor and shields.
factions.name: Corrupted
factions.weak: Corrosive + Radiation covers nearly everything; Viral once armor is stripped. Ancients are the priority target.

factions.desc: Adapt to damage types, gaining up to 95% resistance per type. Bring burst and a reset.
factions.name: Sentient
factions.weak: Void damage resets their adaptation stacks. Operator amps strip adaptation — then dump your heaviest burst before they re-adapt.

factions.desc: Veilbreaker/Kullervo-era hybrids of Corpus and Grineer tech; bosses use damage attenuation.
factions.name: Narmer
factions.weak: Treat like their base faction (Magnetic/Toxin for Narmer Corpus, Corrosive/Viral for Narmer Grineer). Bosses need sustained DPS through attenuation windows, not one big hit.

gating.detail: When your shields fully deplete, you gain ~1.3 seconds of invulnerability. Shield-gating builds (Brief Respite, Augur mods, Pillage/Condemn) exploit this by constantly breaking and restoring small shields for near-permanent i-frames. Enemies get a brief version of the same protection when their shields break.
gating.title: Shield gating

gating.detail: Bosses, Liches, Sisters and Acolytes phase-gate at HP thresholds, becoming invulnerable and changing behavior. You can't burst through a gate — learn each boss's phases instead.
gating.title: Health gating

gating.detail: Eximus units and some bosses carry Overguard: a separate bonus health bar that makes them immune to crowd control and most ability effects while it holds. Strip it with raw damage first — then CC and abilities work normally.
gating.title: Overguard

gating.detail: Armor grants damage reduction that scales with enemy level: at high levels even 50% armor means a fraction of your damage gets through. This is why armor strip (full or near-full) matters more than raw damage past level 100.
gating.title: Armor damage reduction

meta.detail: Hunter Munitions gives your crits a 30% chance to apply a Slash proc. Bleed ticks ignore armor entirely and deal True damage — and Viral's +325% health multiplier applies to those ticks. Build: high crit + Hunter Munitions + Viral weighting = the standard Steel Path killer on rifles and bows.
meta.title: Viral + Hunter Munitions

meta.detail: Corrosive Projection (aura) strips 18% of enemy armor per squadmate running it, stacking across the squad. Four auras = 72% armor gone before the mission even starts, which stacks with Corrosive procs and ability strips.
meta.title: Corrosive Projection stacking

meta.detail: Full strip (armor bar completely removed via abilities like Pillage/Terrify) means enemies take raw health damage — armor-typed damage bonuses stop mattering and Viral/Heat take over. Partial strip (Corrosive procs, CP) leaves scaling DR behind, so you still want armor-bonus damage types. Know which one your build achieves.
meta.title: Full strip vs partial strip

meta.detail: Every status caps at 10 stacks; new procs refresh duration. Prioritize: get to 10 stacks of your key status fast (fire rate, multishot), then let DoTs work. Heat (50% strip + panic) and Viral (+325% health damage) are the two most valuable full stacks in the game.
meta.title: The 10-stack rule

types.desc: Stagger and ragdoll procs. Solid all-rounder; Impact-weighted weapons chunk Corpus shields.
types.name: Impact

types.desc: Each stack reduces the enemy's damage output by 3%, up to 30% at 10 stacks. Defensive utility on tanky builds.
types.name: Puncture

types.desc: Bleed: True-damage ticks that IGNORE armor, scaling with your weapon's base damage mods — and the ticks themselves can crit. The premier anti-armor status.
types.name: Slash

types.bonus: Bonus vs Cloned Flesh / Infested Flesh
types.desc: Ignites enemies: panic CC plus strips 50% armor at 10 stacks. Also the engine of Heat-inherit builds (stacking Heat across weapons).
types.name: Heat

types.desc: Slows enemies up to 75% at 10 stacks; fully-stacked enemies freeze solid and take bonus crit damage when shattered. Defensive and offensive in one.
types.name: Cold

types.desc: Stuns and chains lightning to nearby enemies. Great crowd zapper on Corpus maps.
types.name: Electric

types.desc: Damage-over-time that BYPASSES shields and hits health directly. The reason Toxin builds delete Corpus.
types.name: Toxin

types.desc: Explosions knock enemies down and reduce their accuracy. Reworked into a proper CC element.
types.name: Blast

types.desc: Each stack permanently strips armor — up to 80% gone at 10 stacks. The classic answer to Grineer armor.
types.name: Corrosive

types.desc: Spawns a Toxin cloud around the target that melts nearby enemies. AoE poison for dense packs.
types.name: Gas

types.desc: Disrupts and strips enemy shields, delaying their regen. The dedicated Corpus-shield answer.
types.name: Magnetic

types.desc: Confuses enemies so they attack each other. Turns crowds into a civil war — strong vs Corpus robotics and Grineer elites.
types.name: Radiation

types.desc: Each stack increases ALL damage the enemy's HEALTH takes — up to +325% at 10 stacks. The most important status in the game; every endgame build wants Viral weighting.
types.name: Viral

types.desc: Resets Sentient damage adaptation and disrupts them. Niche elsewhere, mandatory vs Eidolons and Sentient ships.
types.name: Void

types.desc: Rare damage type from Incarnon adapters and Tauforged gear. Its status weakens enemies to further damage — still being explored by the meta.
types.name: Tau

types.desc: Not an element — True damage (Bleed ticks, finishers) bypasses armor, shields and resistances entirely. This is why Slash outscales everything at high levels.
types.name: True
